newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Auto accident kills 18 in China's Xiamen city.
newsitem.headline: Auto accident kills 18 in China's Xiamen city.

text.p: Eighteen people were killed on Monday when a minibus and a car collided in Xiamen city in China's southeastern Fujian province, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Thursday.

A minibus with 22 passengers, a driver and a ticket seller collided with a car on a bridge, slammed through the bridge's railings and fell to the ground below, said the newspaper, published in the city of Shenzhen bordering Hong Kong.
Sixteen people died immediately in the overturned bus and two were certified dead after being rushed to hospital, it said.
The four in the car escaped injuries, but police probes indicate the driver was violating traffic rules, it said. He has been detained by police for further investigation.
More than 240,000 people were killed or injured in traffic accidents in China in 1996, the official media has reported.
